/*********************1********************************/
SELECT TABLE_NAME, 
COLUMN_NAME, 
CASE WHEN DATA_TYPE = 'nvarchar' THEN DATA_TYPE + '(' + CAST(CHARACTER_MAXIMUM_LENGTH AS varchar(10)) + ')' 
	 WHEN DATA_TYPE = 'varchar' THEN DATA_TYPE + '(' + CAST(CHARACTER_MAXIMUM_LENGTH AS varchar(10)) + ')' 
	 WHEN DATA_TYPE = 'char' THEN DATA_TYPE + '(' + CAST(CHARACTER_MAXIMUM_LENGTH AS varchar(10)) + ')' 
	 WHEN DATA_TYPE = 'numeric' THEN DATA_TYPE + '(' + CAST(NUMERIC_PRECISION AS varchar(10)) + ',' + CAST(NUMERIC_SCALE AS varchar(10)) + ')' 
	 WHEN DATA_TYPE = 'decimal' THEN DATA_TYPE + '(' + CAST(NUMERIC_PRECISION AS varchar(10)) + ',' + CAST(NUMERIC_SCALE AS varchar(10)) + ')' 
	 WHEN DATA_TYPE IN ('datetime','datetime2', 'date', 'int', 'bigint', 'tinyint', 'float', 'smallint','bit','time') THEN DATA_TYPE
	 WHEN DATA_TYPE = 'bit' THEN DATA_TYPE + '(' + CAST(NUMERIC_PRECISION AS varchar(10)) + ',' + CAST(NUMERIC_SCALE AS varchar(10)) + ')'
	 END AS DATA_TYPE,
	 LEFT(IS_NULLABLE,1) IS_NULLABLE			 
FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS 
WHERE TABLE_NAME IN ('DEP_EODACCOUNTBALANCE_20231218_day1') and TABLE_SCHEMA = 'busc'
ORDER BY 1

alter table busc.DEP_EODACCOUNTBALANCE
alter column ACID varchar(11) not null
alter table busc.DEP_EODACCOUNTBALANCE
alter column EOD_DATE date not null
alter table busc.DEP_EODACCOUNTBALANCE
alter column END_EOD_DATE date null
alter table busc.DEP_EODACCOUNTBALANCE
alter column LCHG_USER_ID varchar(15) null
alter table busc.DEP_EODACCOUNTBALANCE
alter column RCRE_USER_ID varchar(15) null
alter table busc.DEP_EODACCOUNTBALANCE
alter column EAB_CRNCY_CODE varchar(3) null

alter table busc.DEP_EODACCOUNTBALANCE
alter column BANK_ID varchar(8) not null


/*********************2********************************/
select 'Source' tables, count(1) cnt from d360.STG_DEP_EODACCOUNTBALANCE_CM49_20231130 where h = 'd' 
UNION ALL
select 'Target' tables, count(1) cnt from busc.DEP_EODACCOUNTBALANCE_20231218_day1

/*********************3********************************/
SELECT COUNT(1) null_cnt from (
SELECT * from busc.DEP_EODACCOUNTBALANCE_20231218_day1 WHERE
 ACID IS NULL OR
 EOD_DATE IS NULL OR
 END_EOD_DATE IS NULL OR
 TRAN_DATE_BAL IS NULL ) a
 

/*******************************4****************************/
with src as (
    select * from d360.STG_DEP_EODACCOUNTBALANCE_CM49_20231130 stg where h = 'd' 
    and not EXISTS (
        select * from  busc.DEP_EODACCOUNTBALANCE_20231218_day1  
    )
), tgt as (
    select * from  busc.DEP_EODACCOUNTBALANCE_20231218_day1 tgt
    where not EXISTS (
        select * from d360.STG_DEP_EODACCOUNTBALANCE_CM49_20231130 stg where h = 'd' 
    )
)

select 'SRC' tables, count(1) cnt from src 
union all
select 'TGT' tables, count(1) cnt from tgt 

 /************************************5********************************/
 select count(1) dup_cnt from (
    select ACID,EOD_DATE,BANK_ID from busc.DEP_EODACCOUNTBALANCE_20231218_day1 GROUP BY ACID,EOD_DATE,BANK_ID HAVING COUNT(1)>1)A


/***********************************6********************************/

SELECT
 'STG' TABLES
,SUM(CONVERT(NUMERIC(25,4),TRAN_DATE_BAL)) AS TRAN_DATE_BAL
,SUM(CONVERT(NUMERIC(25,4),TRAN_DATE_TOT_TRAN)) AS TRAN_DATE_TOT_TRAN
,SUM(CONVERT(NUMERIC(25,4),VALUE_DATE_BAL)) AS VALUE_DATE_BAL
,SUM(CONVERT(NUMERIC(25,4),VALUE_DATE_TOT_TRAN)) AS VALUE_DATE_TOT_TRAN
FROM d360.STG_DEP_EODACCOUNTBALANCE_CM49_20231130 where h = 'd' 
UNION ALL
SELECT
 'TGT' TABLES
,SUM(TRAN_DATE_BAL) AS TRAN_DATE_BAL
,SUM(TRAN_DATE_TOT_TRAN) AS TRAN_DATE_TOT_TRAN
,SUM(VALUE_DATE_BAL) AS VALUE_DATE_BAL
,SUM(VALUE_DATE_TOT_TRAN) AS VALUE_DATE_TOT_TRAN
FROM  busc.DEP_EODACCOUNTBALANCE_20231218_day1
